none.description: No rounding; flat edge in compound shapes (accordion, combobox, nav joins)

subtle.description: Barely softened corners on small square elements (checkbox, sm date/time pickers)

small.description: Compact rounding (chips, icons, inputchip, tab partials)

medium.description: Default surface rounding (card, input, dialog, listitem, toast)

large.description: More prominent rounding (statictoggle, softer bounded controls)

pill.description: Capsule / pill silhouette (button pill, buttongroup, sidenav, nav)

full.description: True circle (avatar, radio, slider thumb, presence)
